verdict.rationale: Claude Code supports running multiple sessions/tasks in parallel (docs-13, docs-14, docs-26) and even parallel subagents (docs-56), which enables running several attempts concurrently, but there's no documented feature for comparing/diffing results across parallel attempts or a UI specifically for picking the best of several parallel task runs — the parallelism described is mostly about splitting work across subtasks or running independent sessions, not explicit 'multiple attempts at the same task' comparison workflow. missing for 10: dedicated UI/workflow for spawning N attempts at the same task and diffing/comparing outcomes side-by-side before selecting one, independent hands-on confirmation of this specific comparison workflow.
